causal_representation_identifiability.question_en: How do latent causal variables become identifiable from high-dimensional observations, and what supervision or intervention makes that possible?
causal_representation_identifiability.question_zh: 高维观测中的潜在因果变量如何变得可识别？需要什么样的监督或干预？
causal_representation_identifiability.reading_en: The case has two 2020 starting points. DEAR puts a structural causal model into a disentangled generative model, so the latent factors may be causally related rather than independent. Causal Curiosity gives an RL agent an intrinsic reward for experiments that reveal causal factors. A citation path then runs from Causal Curiosity through causal-influence detection to iCITRIS and the interventional representation papers. The path crosses from RL exploration into representation learning; it is a citation path, not proof that the later paper inherited the earlier method.
causal_representation_identifiability.reading_zh: 这个案例有两个 2020 年的起点。DEAR 把结构因果模型放进解耦生成模型，允许潜在因子之间存在因果关系，而不是强行独立。Causal Curiosity 用内在奖励让 RL agent 主动做实验、发现因果因子。随后一条引用路径从 Causal Curiosity 经过 causal influence detection 走到 iCITRIS 和干预式表示学习。这条路径从 RL 探索跨到表示学习，是引用路径，不证明后者继承了前者的方法。

key_edges.note_en: RL agent discovers experiments; later work measures situation-dependent causal influence.
key_edges.note_zh: RL agent 主动发现实验；后续工作度量情境相关的因果影响。

key_edges.note_en: Influence detection in RL; later work learns causal representations with instantaneous effects.
key_edges.note_zh: RL 中的影响检测；后续工作学习含瞬时效应的因果表示。

key_edges.note_en: Both study interventional data for representation learning, with different identification assumptions.
key_edges.note_zh: 两篇都用干预数据做表示学习，但识别假设不同。

causal_representation_identifiability.limits_en: The corpus starts in 2019. Earlier representation-learning work outside the corpus is not counted, so 'origin' means earliest cited paper in this set.
causal_representation_identifiability.limits_zh: 语料从 2019 年开始。语料之外的早期表示学习工作不计入，因此“起源”指这组论文中最早被引用的论文。

distribution_shift_ood.question_en: When the test distribution moves, which causal object should stay invariant, and how is that object learned or evaluated?
distribution_shift_ood.question_zh: 测试分布移动时，哪个因果对象应当保持不变？这个对象如何学习或评估？
distribution_shift_ood.reading_en: Causal Confusion (2019) frames distribution shift in imitation learning as causal misidentification: more information can make the policy worse when the model learns spurious correlates. The only forward path in this case goes through a 2021 systematic evaluation of causal discovery in visual model-based RL, then to a 2022 method that learns to induce causal structure. The path runs through a benchmark, which is a problem-formulation link, not a method descendant. The family is thin: the largest in-family hub has four citations.
distribution_shift_ood.reading_zh: Causal Confusion（2019）把模仿学习中的分布偏移表述为因果误识别：当模型学到虚假相关时，更多信息反而可能让策略更差。这个案例唯一的前向路径经过 2021 年一篇视觉模型 RL 中因果发现的系统评估，再到 2022 年一篇学习因果结构的方法。路径经过 benchmark，是问题表述的链接，不是方法继承。这个家族很薄：族内最大枢纽只有 4 次引用。

key_edges.note_en: Causal confusion in imitation learning; later benchmark evaluates causal discovery in visual model-based RL.
key_edges.note_zh: 模仿学习中的因果混淆；后续 benchmark 评估视觉模型 RL 中的因果发现。

key_edges.note_en: Benchmark paper; later method learns a data-to-graph mapping and tests distribution shift.
key_edges.note_zh: Benchmark 论文；后续方法学习从数据到图的映射，并测试分布偏移。

distribution_shift_ood.limits_en: The OOD family has 40 labelled method papers but only 18 internal edges among them. A thin subgraph is a finding, not a failed search.
distribution_shift_ood.limits_zh: OOD 家族有 40 篇带标签的方法论文，但族内只有 18 条内部引用边。子图稀疏本身是结论，不是检索失败。

llm_causal_reasoning.question_en: Can a language model perform causal inference, or only talk about causal facts it saw in text?
llm_causal_reasoning.question_zh: 语言模型能做因果推断，还是只会复述它在文本里见过的因果事实？
llm_causal_reasoning.reading_en: This is a 2023 burst, not a temporal chain. The corpus has a capability claim (Causal Reasoning and LLMs), a skeptical position (Causal Parrots), two benchmarks (Corr2Cause and CLadder), and methods that use LLM output as an input to causal discovery or as a causal-order interface. There is no forward citation path from an origin to a later hub inside the corpus: the hubs and the origin candidates are all in 2023. B therefore reports a cluster with two positions and two evaluation branches, not a lineage.
llm_causal_reasoning.reading_zh: 这是 2023 年的集中爆发，不是时间上的链条。语料里有一篇能力主张（Causal Reasoning and LLMs）、一篇怀疑立场（Causal Parrots）、两个 benchmark（Corr2Cause 和 CLadder），以及把 LLM 输出作为因果发现输入或因果顺序接口的方法。语料内没有从起源到后续枢纽的前向引用路径：枢纽和起源候选都集中在 2023 年。因此 B 报告的是一个包含两种立场和两条评估分支的簇，不是谱系。

key_edges.note_en: Capability claim; later benchmark tests formal causal inference rules.
key_edges.note_zh: 能力主张；后续 benchmark 测试形式化因果推断规则。

key_edges.note_en: Skeptical position; benchmark asks whether models infer causation from correlation.
key_edges.note_zh: 怀疑立场；benchmark 检验模型能否从相关推断因果。

key_edges.note_en: LLM as imperfect expert for discovery; later work uses causal order as the stable interface.
key_edges.note_zh: LLM 作为不完美专家做发现；后续工作把因果顺序作为更稳定的接口。

llm_causal_reasoning.limits_en: With no forward path, this case cannot support a descent claim. It can support a cluster description and a dated comparison of positions.
llm_causal_reasoning.limits_zh: 没有前向路径，这个案例不能支持“传承”主张。它支持簇描述和带日期的立场比较。
